newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba says to help in Time Warner data service.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba says to help in Time Warner data service.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Wednesday it would work as system integrator and key equipment supplier for Time Warner Inc's planned high-speed on-line broadband cable service in Portland, Maine.

Toshiba said it was supplying a complete on-line cable data system to the U.S. media and entertainment company, consisting of a head-end including the switch and the client server computer at the cable station as well as distribution hubs and cable modems at subscriber's homes.
With the system, Portland subscribers will be able to access Time Warner's Road Runner on-line service, which offers local content, existing on-line services.
The Portland system is the second collaboration between Toshiba and Time Warner under an agreement for cable systems signed last December, Toshiba said in a statement.
Toshiba said it had also served as system integrator and key equipment supplier in technical trials for a similar cable data system installed in Time Warner's San Diego operation.
